19:12 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NBA Basketball
The 76ers host the Cavaliers in an NBA regular-season game at Xfinity Mobile Arena. The Cavaliers has won four of its last five games against the 76ers. James Harden leads the Cavaliers into another season, while the 76ers relies on Tyrese Maxey.

21:35 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The Thunder host the Nuggets in an NBA regular-season game. Oklahoma City lead the recent head-to-head trend against Denver, winning four of their last five games. Denver look to Marvin Bagley III, while Oklahoma City counters with Brooks Barnhizer.
